scope: Frozen Devices method declarations and their consumer/dependency review obligations

groups.note: Use admitted FanRoute and its existing writer/return contract; a method declaration is not an available route.
Retain actual protocol/return dependencies inside the fan consumer; no direct public helper invocation.
Action eligibility comes from the reviewed lighting model/action catalog, including disabled actions.
Helpers remain implementation dependencies of admitted actions, with their original transport/lifecycle guards.
Exact reviewed identities and firmware/readback policies remain authoritative; SuiPlay is not enabled from inherited declarations.
Internal EC bypass dependency; never a second independent writer.
User permits source/model/CPU metadata only; no CPU/TDP takeover or GPU consumer is authorized.
Reconcile vendor event authority with actual native OEM capture/action; source mention alone does not prove the transport.
Physical protocol configuration and controller identity/ownership require method-specific reconciliation; do not expose these methods as generic commands.
Preserve owned listener lifetime and transport/source identity; common method names do not imply interchangeable protocols.
Windows/controller source selection and sample authority stay in existing motion consumers.
Class-specific initialization, shared device ownership, event detach and release remain explicit review obligations; do not start HC managers from this registry.
Handlers may mix hardware effects and HC application policy; port only necessary device dependencies, not the entire settings UI.
Review each initializer: Flip display defaults include HC application preferences, which are not automatically a required hardware capability.
Shared EC/WMI/driver/UEFI access must retain the actual owner and lifecycle; a helper is not a stand-alone admitted hardware action.
Installation/registry/device restart side effects are recorded only; this offline tool never performs them.
Charger/power context may affect device behavior; retain source and require consumer-specific proof.
Preserve per-model button metadata; this does not authorize importing HC UI or establish a runtime UI consumer.

Exact Flip DS and explicitly source-inherited Flip 1S DS ACPI EC secondary-display consumers are connected in this source candidate. No OverlayQuickTools/keyboard/trackpad UI import; runtime readiness, one-use read fences and source-pinned two-model registration remain authoritative. Mainline promotion, global software acceptance, package and physical effects are separate.
sideEffects: ACPI EC byte-register latch0x4F=0 then brightness0x4E with readback; no SuperIO ports
Persistent display preference only after verified explicit operation; no automatic startup/resume/release brightness write

groups.note: Keep exact source utility provenance; determine sharing through actual callers rather than adding another public capability.

Only the existing enabled MSI SD rear preparation consumer binds the same original report factory through total-library model/endpoint/firmware references. Native keyboard remains record-only with unchanged source and a false build lock. Shared profile fields and persistent sync are not physically accepted.
sideEffects: Existing M1/M2 shared profile writes and SyncToROM only after original consumer admission; no new startup/mode/automatic retry/restore behavior
